unlock_gates.description: P0.11 is merged to protected main and provides the accepted interaction-state traceability baseline.
P0.12 must merge to protected main before any child implementation issue can leave blocked status.
The user must explicitly reopen local and Codex implementation work after the current temporary block.
A future implementation branch must begin from the then-current protected-main SHA with a clean intended delta.
The exact child issue being implemented must be intentionally unblocked without broadening the other issue packages.
Production catalog, provider, package, default Tale, Tale Library, and export exclusions must be reverified at implementation start.
The implementing issue must define its exact automated checks and failure evidence before merge review.
Issues 7, 39, and 44 must remain accurately represented without suppression, substitution, or premature closure.

work_packages.title: Prototype isolation boundary
work_packages.objective: Create an unmistakable development-only boundary that cannot enter normal Tale selection, production catalog identity, or ordinary exports.
allowed_outputs: Development-only isolation and fail-closed entry seams
prohibited_outputs: Production Tale catalog or default-Tale change
Production provider or package registration
Player-visible locked or coming-soon Tale entry
Public or ordinary portable playable export

work_packages.title: Deterministic state and projection fixtures
work_packages.objective: Provide synthetic authoritative source and result revisions for representative public, private, transition, and recovery interactions.
prohibited_outputs: Production saves or authored player history
Production Tale package or provider identity
Network, telemetry, cloud, upload, or credential dependency
Final mechanics or balance claims

work_packages.title: Low-Tide shared-screen prototype shell
work_packages.objective: Project the Low-Tide shared-screen contract with synthetic public state, controller-first focus, persistent text, captions, and stable-seat ownership.
prohibited_outputs: Final board geometry, camera, or production scene
Final visual, audio, localization, or imported production asset
Physical-controller or television-readability claim
Complete Tale progression or balance result

work_packages.title: Bellhouse decision and invalid-action recovery
work_packages.objective: Prove one public Bellhouse decision can preview, cancel, commit once, and recover from invalid input without mutation or leakage.
allowed_outputs: Bellhouse decision projection and focus flow
Command guard and deterministic reducer seam
Invalid-action recovery and focus restoration tests
prohibited_outputs: Final Ledger mechanics or narrative timing
Hidden-state hint, correct-answer glow, or moral recommendation
Penalty, ridicule, deadlock, RNG consumption, or seat reset on rejection
Human comprehension or fun claim

work_packages.title: Controlled-private neutral shield proof
work_packages.objective: Prove neutral shared shielding, authorized private delivery, acknowledgement, clearing, and safe fallback with synthetic private data.
allowed_outputs: Private clearing and interruption recovery tests
prohibited_outputs: Private payload in public display, audio, captions, transcript, replay, diagnostics, or mirroring
Timeout acceptance, default-confirm focus, or private-seat shopping
Production Companion endpoint or account identity change
Privacy or security certification claim

work_packages.title: High Water deterministic transformation proof
work_packages.objective: Prove the committed before-state, exactly-once High Water transformation, skip-equivalent presentation, and transformed public board projection.
allowed_outputs: Before-state, changed-category summary, and after-state projections
prohibited_outputs: Final water simulation, camera, animation, art, or audio
Player input, RNG branch, or authority transfer during transition
Hidden-state leak or stable-seat replacement
Human comprehension, pacing, or balance claim

work_packages.title: Prototype automation and export exclusion
work_packages.objective: Create exact-head automated evidence for deterministic behavior, privacy, deadlock resistance, catalog integrity, and ordinary-export exclusion.
allowed_outputs: Headless deterministic and privacy regression tests
Explicitly bounded internal prototype build evidence after separate review
prohibited_outputs: Suppression or reinterpretation of issue 44
Closure or substitution of issue 39 human evidence
Public release or ordinary portable prototype bundle
Claims of controller, television, accessibility, privacy, fun, fairness, or balance validation

external_gates.summary: Working game and host names remain provisional and may not support final legal, storefront, domain, or marketing claims.
Human household and remote playtest evidence remains open; automated prototype checks are not human evidence.
The Companion dependency vulnerability remains open and requires real remediation rather than suppression or reinterpretation.

promotion_requirements: Separate production-authorization release and exact-head review
Reviewed Tale package, provider, catalog, and Tale Library identity
Production asset provenance, licenses, and replacement status
Final localization, captions, transcript, and narrative packaging
Save, replay, migration, performance, and deterministic compatibility
Human accessibility, privacy, comprehension, pacing, fun, fairness, and balance evidence
Legal-name, storefront, rating, release, and marketing readiness
approval_boundary: P0.12 conditionally approves only the future isolated prototype concept and blocked issue decomposition; it authorizes no runtime file, production Tale registration, provider or catalog change, playable export, production asset, human evidence claim, or public release activity.
